_meta.description: Explicit instruments.sector -> IX-1 tracked-index-key mapping for SectorHealthEngine (SD-2 / DD-12). Deliberately not exhaustive: only sectors with a genuinely close NSE sectoral-index match are mapped. Unmapped sectors (Financial Services, Capital Goods, Chemicals, Power/telecom/etc. not listed below) report SectorHealth unavailable -- never guessed by string similarity. 'Healthcare' -> nifty_pharma and 'Oil Gas & Consumable Fuels'/'Power' -> nifty_energy are documented approximations (pharma is the dominant NSE-listed healthcare segment; NIFTY ENERGY spans the broader oil/gas/power complex), not exact matches.
